name: cost-benefit-analysis
description: Build a business case with costs, benefits, and ROI. Use when the user says "cost-benefit analysis", "business case", "ROI calculation", "is this worth it", "justify the investment", "payback period", "benefits realization", "financial justification", "total cost of ownership", "should we build or buy", "investment appraisal" - even if they don't explicitly say "CBA".
